title: Redo Credit on Cancelled Tailwise Grooming Salon Passes
content:
A prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass) that has had free satisfaction redos earns a redo credit in its refund when it is cancelled.

**Rule.** The redo credit on a cancelled pass counts every redone visit at the per-visit paid rate multiplied by the redo share, and the redo share follows the free redos recorded on the pass:

| Free redos recorded on the pass | Redo share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1 (the full rate) |
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| none | zero — no credit |

The per-visit paid rate is the price paid divided by the visits purchased. The redo credit is added to the refund in full, as an amount alongside the unused value rather than part of it.

**What is counted.** Every free redo entry in the salon history of the pass counts once, whichever visit it redid.

**Credit worked out (hypothetical pass with a per-visit paid rate of 64.26)**

| Redos on the pass | Calculation | Redo credit |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | — | 0.00 |
| 1 | one redo at 64.26 multiplied by 0.5 | 32.13 |
| 2 | two redos at 64.26 multiplied by 1 | 128.52 |
| 3 | three redos at 64.26 multiplied by 1 | 192.78 |
